newsitem.title: USA: Standex sees lower Q3 March 31 earnings.
newsitem.headline: Standex sees lower Q3 March 31 earnings.

text.p: Standex International Corp said Tuesday it expects earnings for the third fiscal quarter ended March 31 to be below last year's $5.6 million, or $0.41 per share.
The company said it expects fourth quarter earnings to about equal or slightly exceed year-earlier results.

Standex said that although third-quarter sales appear very close to last year's $130 million, profits are expected to be hurt by several factors, including difficulties in assimilating some acquisitions, greater-than-expected restructuring costs at one of the divisions, and increased competitive pressures for some business units.

But Standex said its backlog is higher than last year, and it is working closely with the operating divisions to be sure they are reducing their overhead costs as necessary to reflect the market situation.
Standex makes industrial products, graphics/mail order, and institutional products.
